confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live booking pages or current listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately certain. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July is peak season and accommodation varies widely. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship: cocktail at about 2.3x the beer anchor and wine at about 1.1x. The FX observation was taken from a search-result summary of the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page (15 Oct 2026, 4pm), not from a direct page read; the 16 Oct figures found came from third-party sites and were not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-priced Central European capital, comparable to Ljubljana, Budapest and Prague for food and drink, with accommodation priced between those cities and Vienna during summer peak demand. Croatia uses the euro.
